name: Duke of Weselton's Favorites: Nordic Meats, Cheeses & Knäckebröd (Wonder Alaska)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Freezing the Night Away Menu (Alaska Sailings)
whyItWorks: Aged Nordic cheeses and cured meats are lactose-safe, but hard seeded rye crispbread (Knäckebröd) and pickled vegetables are rough.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the aged cheese and lean cured meat slices with a soft white dinner roll instead of the hard seeded rye crispbread.
